Chapter 2 uses a browser activity; Chapters 15–16 use written reflection and design review, so they do not have companion notebooks.

Some notebooks offer smaller or offline alternatives to the chapter's full experiment. Follow each notebook's setup instructions for additional packages, model downloads, and GPU requirements.

You can also [browse all material files on GitHub](https://github.com/proff-amakobe/oer-books/tree/main/deep-learning/material), including the [notebook inventory and validation notes](../material/NOTEBOOK_INVENTORY.md).
